encoding: ASCII JSON Lines; one object and LF per record; no BOM

integer_representation.all_other_integers: ASCII decimal strings:0 or a nonzero digit followed by digits; no sign,fraction,exponent,leading zero; parse with checked exact integer arithmetic
integer_representation.qpc_and_utc_ticks: positive signed-int64; UTC ticks use .NET UTC DateTime ticks from0001-01-01; successor must specify exact Python conversion without float
integer_representation.frequency: positive signed-int64; exact caller QPC frequency
integer_representation.pid: positive uint32; generation identity comes from original native caller/outer custody,not PID alone
integer_representation.counters: nonnegative signed-int64; null only when explicitly unavailable at that stage

header.op: canonical lowercase UUID of this one operation
header.pp: producer PID,joined to original native process creation FILETIME in external custody records
header.ah: 64 lowercase hex digits of exact admission SHA256

stage_record.s: one stage ID in stages.json for this role
stage_record.q: absolute event QPC,not elapsed floating seconds
stage_record.nf: completed file count for this stage or null
stage_record.nb: completed byte count for this stage or null
stage_record.gs: snapshot of existing owner guard sample count or null
stage_record.counter_semantics: Stage-local completed work only; begin uses0 if known; count at successful existing loop update,never move a validation earlier or skip one. No per-file events or invented completion from length-only metadata.

terminal_record.n: Next contiguous actual sequence1..127; consumes final capacity regardless of its absolute index
terminal_record.lv_scope: owner-local final input/output verification only; never original handle closure or the other role's verification

validation: Require exact key/type/token sets and record caps before append and on readback.
Header0 occurs exactly once first; later sequences are contiguous and all records belong to that role/op/domain.
QPC and UTC never precede caller origin or move backwards within the role; cross-role overlap is allowed and must not be summed as exclusive duration.
An end matches a live begin for the same fixed stage; only declared build subspans may nest. No repeated completed stages. Marks have no invented duration.
Only the normal successful authority check permits pending->verified; it never flips back. Source-stage map defines that transition.
After first failure or normal-capacity exhaustion,only the declared final-capacity suffix is eligible; no normal record resumes and the substantive failure stays latched.
No record follows a terminal; malformed/torn/extra bytes are retained but refuse diagnostic acceptance.
Counters are nondecreasing within their span,never compared as a global total across overlapping stages. A null is unavailable,not0.
External original process generation/native file descriptors bind raw journals; JSON consistency and PID alone are insufficient.
Only independent actual review may adopt OBSERVED_PREFIX_ONLY; every result remains qualification_accepted=false.
derived_timing: After exact subtraction in integer domain,store numerator ticks and denominator frequency; a displayed decimal is a convenience only. Do not route native timestamps through binary-floating JSON numbers.

capacity_classification.transition: First final record permanently ends normal pool; no padding or unused-capacity borrowing
capacity_classification.final: First failure marker,at most one secondary journal-fault marker,role ready-to-close mark C29/S21,and terminal
